text: Moving from a glass-walled conference room bustling with discussion into a vibrant, visually stimulating exhibit space, I experience a sudden shift in atmosphere. The first room, orderly and focused, feels a bit formal and distant—as though I’m observing thought in action from the outside. Entering the R+D exhibit, I’m met with creativity and the excitement of exploration, as if I’ve stepped into an evolving conversation about knowledge and innovation. Here, I feel more at ease, intrigued, and open to discovery—reminded of the restless interplay between deliberation and inspiration.
